# runtime

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-controller/pkg/runtime"
```

Package runtime re\-exports the Runtime type as a public alias. It stays defined in internal/runtime, unchanged; this package exists only so that external test modules have a valid, non\-internal import path to construct one against.

## type [Runtime](<https://github.com/blanketops/environments-controller/blob/main/pkg/runtime/runtime.go#L29>)

Runtime bundles the shared infrastructure every domain and mediator depends on: the field cache, event recorder, domain registry, and command\-dispatch engine.
